plentry.pd: (0): Scales the video proportionally to fill the view. If the aspect ratio of the video does not match the view, the excess part is cropped.
(1): Scales the video proportionally to fit the view. If the aspect ratio of the video does not match the view, the unused area is filled with black bars.
(0): Scales the video proportionally to fill the viewport. If the video size does not match the viewport, the excess part is cropped.
(1): Scales the video proportionally to display the entire video content. If the video size does not match the viewport, black bars are shown in the unfilled area.
0: Video size is scaled proportionally. The priority is to fill the window. Any excess video that does not match the window size will be cropped.

1: Video size is scaled proportionally. The priority is to ensure that all video content is displayed. Any areas of the window that are not filled due to the mismatch between video size and window size will be filled with black.
